name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan to be executed by firing squad, Pentagon says
changes.summary: The Trump administration has approved a plan to execute former Army Maj. Nidal Hasan — who killed 13 people in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood — by firing squad, the Pentagon said.

changes.title: Trump Hits 4 States in 5 Days in Final Push to November Midterms
changes.summary: With four weeks to go until the crucial midterm elections, President Donald Trump is making an all-out push to rally Republicans, trying to appeal to voters on the economy. The president also made rare reversals on mail-in voting and who will pay for the controversial political ads about himself. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez r.

changes.title: Democrats' advantage is clear with less than a month to go in the midterm elections
changes.summary: President Trump is facing low approval ratings, and voters are blaming him for rising costs. Republicans are likely to pay the price at the ballot box next month. (Image credit: Finn Gomez).

changes.title: A history of presidents naming things after themselves (It's short. They rarely do)
changes.summary: While Trump pushes to get his name on the Kennedy Center and other public sites, history shows that sitting presidents have almost always avoided putting their brands on government assets. (Image credit: Alex Wroblewski).

changes.title: As Trump focuses the FBI on immigration, counterintelligence is falling behind
changes.summary: The cuts come as a consequence of President Trump and FBI Director Kash Patel's focus on violent crime and immigration, leaving other priorities understaffed. (Image credit: Win McNamee).

changes.title: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
changes.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View , accusing it of being unfair. (Image credit: Mario Tama).

changes.title: Alito says Supreme Court can't stem rise of emergency appeals, 'not pleased' with Trump's rhetoric
changes.summary: The justice told The Associated Press in a rare interview that the rhetoric about the court from Trump and his administration doesn't sit well with him.

changes.title: Cold War memories stir Rubio in Iceland as he champions diplomacy and downplays differences
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday sought to reassure NATO ally Iceland that President Donald Trump's administration has no designs on the island but shares its deep concerns about Arctic security as tensions between the United States and Russia rise in the high north and elsewhere.

changes.title: After taxpayer-funded ads glorifying Trump sparked backlash, he says his super PAC will pay instead
changes.summary: In a post on his social media site, President Donald Trump defended the ads, which cost at least $1.5 million in federal funds and have drawn intense criticism.

changes.title: Trump Allows Cheaper, Dyed Diesel to Be Used in Nonfarm Vehicles
changes.summary: In Nebraska, President Trump announced an executive order to waive an off-road requirement for the fuel, which is exempt from the federal highway tax.
